findings.title: canManage() grants manage access on the VIEW scope
findings.body: `canManage()` accepts `VIEW` as well as `MANAGE`. An admin with only an all-groups `view` permission passes `requireManage()`. That check guards creating top-level groups, so a view-only admin can create groups. Only the `MANAGE` scope should grant it.

findings.title: Resource id used where the group id (resource name) is expected
findings.body: In V2 the authz resource name is the group id (see `getOrCreateResource`/`resolveGroup`). The resource id is a separate UUID. This code passes `groupResource.getId()` to `hasPermission`, which looks the resource up by name. The lookup misses and falls back to the all-groups type resource. It then adds the resource UUID to the returned set, but callers treat that set as group ids. Users in groups with `view-members` permission are therefore not matched in user searches and counts. Use `groupResource.getName()` in both places. Also skip the type-level resource, which findByType may return.
